acceptanceCriteria: All workspace package versions, Cargo.lock entries, and current tri-language release/versioning guidance identify v0.2.58 without rewriting historical release facts.
The reviewed PR passes hosted checks before an annotated v0.2.58 tag is created from the synchronized default branch.
The public v0.2.58 Release exposes identity-bound archives, SHA256 checksums, SBOM, provenance, and release manifest.
Public adopter and N-1 acceptance use only downloaded immutable artifacts, prove isolation and cleanup, and preserve first-adopter not_ready semantics.
The published binary is installed on this repository and inspect, status, doctor, Agent doctor, and post-close documentation checks remain healthy.
This Work Item completes visible Outcome, archive, finalization, close, and exact branch/worktree cleanup before publication.
goal: Release v0.2.58 from the reviewed mainline and prove the public binary can govern a fresh adopter before resuming the next reference-source comparison batch.
intent: Publish an immutable v0.2.58 Runtime release after the WI-490 terminal documentation gate fix, validate the downloaded public artifact in isolated adopter and N-1 flows, install it on this repository, and then return to reference comparison.
outOfScope: Reference source or object/adopter repository changes
Source checkout or workspace binary fallback
